:::: {.quiz}

::: {.question}
What does this print?

```{.python}
xs = [1, 2, 3]
print(xs[1:])
```
:::

::: {.answer .incorrect}
`[1, 2]`
:::

::: {.answer .correct}
`[2, 3]`
:::

::: {.solution}
A slice starts at the index you give and runs to the end.
:::

::: {.explanation}
Worth saying out loud: the second number is the *end*, not a count.
:::

:::: {.quiz .incremental}

::: {.question}
Which of these are immutable in Python?
:::

::: {.answer .correct}
`tuple`
:::

::: {.answer .incorrect}
`list`
:::

::: {.answer .correct}
`str`
:::

::: {.answer .incorrect}
`dict`
:::

::: {.solution}
`tuple` and `str` — two answers are correct here.
:::

::: {.explanation}
The `.incremental` class reveals the answers one at a time on the slide.
:::
